# Synopsis: *Legacy: A Sanguine Relics Novel (Lobera)*
### Book One of the Sanguine Relics Series

**Author**: Raymond Bayly  
**Series**: *Sanguine Relics Series* (Book 1 of 3)  
**Genre**: Urban Dark Fantasy / Historical Paranormal Thriller  
**Length**: ~38,847 words · 22 Chapters + Epilogue  
**Formats Available**: DOCX, Markdown  

---

## Part I: Retail Back Cover Blurb

> *"Lobera does not serve the blood of tyrants. It answers only to the blood of the righteous arbiter—forged not to exterminate the beast, but to preserve the sacred covenant between species."*

***

extra.section_header: An ancient holy relic. A dormant Pleistocene genome. And an ordinary man caught between fanatical inquisitors and an honorable pack.
